gloss: big appetite; eating a large amount

definitions.gloss: eating a large amount; big appetite; gluttony
definitions.explanation: Eating a great deal, or a person who eats a lot. The antonym of {小食|しょうしょく} (light eater). Also seen in {大食漢|たいしょくかん} (a big eater) and the colloquial reading {大食|おおぐ}い (heavy eating; eating contest).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大食|たいしょく}だ。
{大食|たいしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: Overeating is not good for your health.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大食|たいしょく}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{小食|しょうしょく}→小食：16900_shoushoku⟧になった。
examples.english: I was a big eater when I was young, but I've become a light eater with age.

notes:
The antonym of ⟦{小食|しょうしょく}→小食：16900_shoushoku⟧ (light eater). Describes eating a large amount, or a person who does so.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大食漢|たいしょくかん}→大食漢：29352_taishokukan⟧: a big eater (person)
- {大食|たいしょく}⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧: a heavy eater
- {大食|たいしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{慎|つつし}む→慎む：09158_tsutsushimu⟧: to refrain from overeating

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小食|しょうしょく}→小食：16900_shoushoku⟧: light eater — the direct antonym
- {大食|おおぐ}い: heavy eating; eating contest — the more colloquial reading
